title: 10 CFR 50.59 Changes, tests, and experiments (CFR edition revised as of 1-1-97)
date_basis: effective_from = effective date of the last amendment in this text (61 FR 39278, 'EFFECTIVE DATE: August 28, 1996.'); effective_to = effective date of the 1999 revision per 65 FR 77773 ('is March 13, 2001'); issue_date null because the CFR volume's printing date is not stated (edition is 'as of' 1997-01-01).
notes: Pre-1999 'unreviewed safety question' text. Paragraphs (a)-(c) are the text in force during the April 1996 EA-98-155 pump change; 61 FR 39278 only ADDED paragraphs (d) and (e) (effective 1996-08-28). The 1996 CFR edition of Title 10 is not on GovInfo (bulkdata/CFR/1996 lists only titles 21, 40, 42-50), so the 1-1-97 edition is the earliest available print. Page 1 of the PDF also carries the tail of 50.58.

title: 10 CFR 50.59 Changes, tests, and experiments (CFR edition revised as of 1-1-01)
date_basis: effective_from from the edition's own EFFECTIVE DATE NOTE and 65 FR 77773 DATES ('is March 13, 2001'); effective_to = effective date of 66 FR 64737 ('EFFECTIVE DATE: December 14, 2001.').
notes: Text of 64 FR 53613 (published 1999-10-04). TRAP: the same new text is already printed in the 1-1-2000 CFR edition (raw/govinfo/CFR-2000-title10-vol1-sec50-59.pdf, kept on disk but not listed as a separate version) even though it did not take effect until 2001-03-13; during all of 2000 the old text still governed.

notes: Amendatory instruction 21 adds 50.59(d),(e). PDF also contains neighbouring FR documents on shared pages.

title: Changes, Tests, and Experiments (final rule revising 10 CFR 50.59)
date_basis: issue_date = FR publication 1999-10-04; effective_from is for 50.59 only: the rule says 50.59 becomes effective '90 days after issuance of applicable regulatory guidance', fixed as March 13, 2001 by 65 FR 77773.
notes: KEY CASE: issue 1999-10-04, 50.59 effective 2001-03-13 (17 months later, set by a later document). Part 72 sections effective 2000-02-01; 72.212/72.48 effective 2001-04-05. federalregister.gov API reports effective_on=2000-02-01 for this document, which is wrong for 50.59. 50.59 text is at 64 FR 53613 (PDF page 32). Page 1 begins with the end of an unrelated OPM rule.

title: Changes, Tests, and Experiments: Confirmation of Effective Date and Availability of Guidance
date_basis: issue_date = FR publication; this notice has no effective date of its own and sets 50.59's effective date to 2001-03-13.
notes: Announces RG 1.187 (Rev 0). Its DATES line says 'October 9, 1999 amendment' (sic; the rule was published October 4, 1999); federalregister.gov API reports effective_on=1999-10-09, parsed from that typo. Do not trust structured FR metadata here.
